headline: Police officer injured as two restaurants attacked in Rajshahi
summary: The attack, sparked by a dispute over food, involved vandalism and the explosion of cocktails cocktails, leaving a police officer injured.
details: Two restaurants owned by the same person in Rajshahi were attacked and vandalized on Friday night.
The incident occurred around 10:45 PM near Rajshahi University, sparking widespread chaos.
Attackers used cocktails to target the establishments, leading to explosions that injured a police officer.
The violence was reportedly triggered by a dispute over the purchase of food.
Police have arrived at the scene to bring the situation under control and are investigating the matter.

headline: One killed, 5 injured in clash between two groups in Chapainawabganj
summary: A violent confrontation between two opposing factions in Chapainawabganj has left one person dead and five others wounded.
details: A clash between two opposing groups in Chapainawabganj resulted in the death of one person and left five others injured.
The incident occurred as tensions escalated between the two factions, leading to a violent confrontation.
The injured individuals have been transported to the local hospital for medical treatment.
Local authorities are investigating the cause of the clash and working to maintain law and order in the area.
